dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: We are enemies, you know? We really shouldn't be chatting this much.

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: If you talk to the enemy too much, you will become close and your heart softens, which puts you at a disadvantage in battle...

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: That's what our instructor told us.
